intro: Your transfers, both cars, the boat to Sifnos and the cooking class, arranged through Original Senses, my partner in Athens. A deposit locks them in; the balance is due a month before you land.

transfers.title: All four island transfers
transfers.note: Paros airport to Vione, Vione to Paros port, Sifnos port to Verina Astra, and Verina Astra to Sifnos port. Luxury vehicle with an English-speaking driver.

boats.title: Paros to Sifnos by private boat, via Antiparos
boats.note: A full day on a 10m RIB with swim stops, a Greek picnic, wine, beer and soft drinks, snorkel gear. Your luggage goes with you and you step off at Sifnos instead of taking the ferry.

photo.alt: A Marvel 10m RIB running past white rock stacks in deep blue water
photo.caption: The Marvel 10m RIB

cars.title: Car on Paros, MG ZS automatic
cars.note: Full cover, unlimited km, second driver, delivered to and collected from Vione.

cars.title: Car on Sifnos, Peugeot 3008 automatic SUV or similar
cars.note: Full cover, unlimited km, delivered to and collected from Verina Astra.

experiences.title: Hands-on cooking in a Sifnian house
experiences.note: With a local cook, then the full meal with Greek wine, beer, tsipouro and homemade lemonade. Transfers both ways.

optional.title: Upgrade the Sifnos crossing to an Axopar 37
optional.note: Covered cabin, captain, water toys, snacks and drinks. Replaces the RIB.

photo.alt: An Axopar 37 with a covered cabin on calm water at sunset
photo.caption: The Axopar 37

optional.title: Marpissa village with a local guide
optional.note: A traditional house (with a homemade spoon sweet) and the folklore museum, entry and transfers included.
